summary: Tested new search bar + category filter feature on /resources (BlogIndex.jsx). All specified test scenarios passed: search input + category filters render correctly, real-time search filtering (case-insensitive, title+excerpt match), clear search button, category filter selection with highlight, combined search+category filtering, empty state with 'Clear filters' reset, and regression checks (Breadcrumbs Home>Resources link, article card navigation to /resources/:slug, sticky nav, footer). No backend testing performed per request (pure client-side filtering, no new API calls).
critical_code_review_comments: BlogIndex.jsx implementation is clean: categories derived dynamically via useMemo from posts data (no hardcoding), filteredPosts computed correctly combining category+search with case-insensitive matching, all required data-testid attributes present exactly as specified.

No issues found - minor stylistic note: categoryColors map is hardcoded per category name, so if a brand-new category appears in future data it will fall back gracefully to default styling (verified via `|| "text-[#0077B3] border-white/10"` fallback), acceptable.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing 147 seeded blog posts
context_for_next_testing_agent: New resources search/filter feature (BlogIndex.jsx) fully verified and passing: initial 'Showing 147 of 147 articles', search 'ransomware' -> 3 results all matching, clear search restores 147, category filter 'Compliance' -> 9 results all with matching badge and highlighted button, combined Compliance+'compliance' search -> 8 results, empty state for 'zzzznonexistent' with working Clear filters button, breadcrumb Home link present, article card navigation to /resources/:slug works and article page renders full content correctly. No regressions found in nav/footer. This is unrelated to SEO Phase 1-4 (iteration_29-33, not re-tested per instructions).
